target_1_occurrence.definition: Whether crop is recorded as cultivated in historical DES records for that district-season.
target_1_occurrence.critical_rule: Historical cultivation is NOT equivalent to agronomic suitability or optimality.

target_2_suitability.definition: Physiological compatibility based on ICAR/SAU evidence.
target_2_suitability.type: 3-Valued: 1 = Suitable, 0 = Unsuitable (explicit negative constraint), -1 = Unknown (missing evidence)

target_3_observed_yield.definition: Empirical historical yield from DES APY records. Strictly conditional on crop occurrence.
target_3_observed_yield.type: Continuous (tonnes/ha) with NaN for uncultivated crops

target_4_economic_returns.definition: Economic profitability computed from CACP MSP and Cost of Cultivation (C2).
